C_RAS.description: Conditioning that provides binned RASA values to the model. Zero denotes no conditioning.

C_SEC.description: Conditioning that provides secondary structure information to the model.

C_HB.description: Conditioning that provides hydrogen bond information (donor/acceptor) to the model.

C_PICATION.description: Conditioning for pi-cation interactions (aromatic ring / cation role).

C_IDXGRP.description:
Indicates atoms within the same equivalence class of known index offsets.

    Does not differentiate between globally indexed vs unindexed groups (that is annotated in
    ``C_IDX.mask``). While the default annotation is monotonically increasing by one, this should
    not be expected to always hold.

    Groups by molecule to ensure that all tokens of one molecule share a group even if they
    are not contiguous in the atom array.

C_CATH.description: Conditioning that provides cath labels to the model. 'x.x.x.x' is null conditioning.

C_INTCRD.description:
Materialized internal-coordinate payload for atoms in non-reserved coordinate groups.

    ``C_CRDGRP`` is the source of truth for membership. These coordinates provide
    group-local structure without fixing the groups' relative positions or orientations.

C_CRDGRP.description: Indicates atoms within the same equivalence class of known relative coordinates.

C_CENTROID.description: Per-chain centroid xyz (Å, ``(n_atoms, 3)``), broadcast per atom; NaN where unincluded.

C_BP.description: NA secondary-structure pair condition (residue semantics, 2-body sparse storage).

C_NA_SS_STATE.description: Per-residue NA secondary-structure state encoded with ``BasePairEnum``.
